newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso gains against dlr in steady trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso gains against dlr in steady trade.

text.p: Colombia's peso strengthed by 1.4 pesos to close at 1,098.5 against the dollar as coffee earnings and petro-dollars were pumped into the foreign exchangemarket, interbank traders said.
"There was demand but from no single specific sector, and the coffee and oil industries were putting greenbacks into the market. Trading was fairly balanced," one dealer said.
The peso hit an intraday high of 1,097.6 and sank to an intraday low of 1,099.5. Dealers reported 305 trades worth a total of $153 million, below the daily average of about $180 million.
